summary: The note describes the Kansas City metropolitan area, a 15-county region centered on Kansas City, Missouri, straddling the Missouri-Kansas state border. It has a population of 2,104,509 and is the second largest metropolitan area with its core in Missouri, after Greater St. Louis. The note names the largest suburbs and notes that the Mid-America Regional Council serves as the area's planning body.
one_line: A 15-county metropolitan area straddling the Missouri-Kansas border, anchored by Kansas City, Missouri, with about 2.1 million people.
key_facts: The Kansas City metropolitan area is a 15-county metropolitan area anchored by Kansas City, Missouri.
The Kansas City metropolitan area straddles the border between the U.S. states of Missouri and Kansas.
The Kansas City metropolitan area had a population of 2,104,509.
The Kansas City metropolitan area ranks as the second largest metropolitan area with its core in Missouri, after Greater St. Louis.
The largest cities and suburbs in the Kansas City metropolitan area include Overland Park, Kansas; Kansas City, Kansas; Olathe, Kansas; and Independence, Missouri.
Overland Park, Kansas, Kansas City, Kansas, Olathe, Kansas, and Independence, Missouri are each over 100,000 in population.
The Mid-America Regional Council (MARC) serves as the Council of Governments for the Kansas City metropolitan area.
The Mid-America Regional Council (MARC) serves as the Metropolitan Planning Organization for the Kansas City metropolitan area.
